result.stderr:
modrelease: the release pipeline for a BepInEx mod. Run from anywhere inside the mod's repository, on a
machine with the game installed. Reads modrelease.json at the repository root.

  dotnet modrelease <command> [options]

Commands
  fingerprint   Print the game fingerprint to record in modrelease.json
  package       Clean-build, package, verify and write the Nexus kit under artifacts/. Warns about anything
                that would stop a release, but goes ahead, so the pipeline can be tried on any commit.
  release       The same, then create the GitHub release and upload the archive. Refuses unless the working
                tree is clean, HEAD carries one pushed v* tag with a CHANGELOG section, and the game on disk
                is the one in modrelease.json. Needs GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment: a fine-grained token
                for the repository with Contents read and write (or a classic token with repo scope).

Options
  --dry-run     release: everything but the GitHub calls
  --draft       release: create the GitHub release as a draft
